Firebase Setup Required

To enable live sync across all users, you need a free Firebase project. Follow these steps once:

1Go to console.firebase.google.com → Create Project → name it yas-roster
2Click Realtime Database → Create Database → Start in test mode
3Go to Project Settings → Your Apps → Web App → Register App → Copy the config
